## IPlayerKnowledge

```java
public interface IPlayerKnowledge
```

The player knowledge contract of the add-on surface.

The native port keeps the knowledge of a player in `thaumcraft.common.lib.research.PlayerKnowledge`; this interface is the public view of it, and `NativePlayerKnowledge` is the implementation that is bound to that native state.

<a id="iplayerknowledge-addknowledge"></a>
```java
boolean addKnowledge(EnumKnowledgeType type, ResearchCategory category, int amount)
```

Adds writable knowledge and reports whether it was accepted. The native TC4 view accepts OBSERVATION as aspect-pool credit. THEORY is a read-only projection of completed research costs, so NativePlayerKnowledge returns false for it without changing player state; it is not a separate TC6 progression balance.

<a id="iplayerknowledge-getknowledge"></a>
```java

```

The knowledge of the category, as the category formula reports it.

<a id="iplayerknowledge-getknowledgeraw"></a>
```java
int getKnowledgeRaw(EnumKnowledgeType type, ResearchCategory category)
```

The raw knowledge of the category, before the category formula. In the native view THEORY sums the category's aspects across completed TC4 research costs.

## NativePlayerKnowledge

```java
public class NativePlayerKnowledge implements IPlayerKnowledge
```

The native `IPlayerKnowledge` implementation.

The completed research, the discovered aspects and the warp live in the native `PlayerKnowledge`; only the per-research stage and flag markers are kept here, because the original surface had no native counterpart for them. OBSERVATION exposes the writable aspect pool; THEORY only reports the costs of completed TC4 research and cannot be credited independently.

```java
public NativePlayerKnowledge(PlayerKnowledge knowledge)
```
